paragraphs: Rabbah bar Levai. Niddah 46b. In Kol Sha'ah 40b he challenged Rava for permitting the sale to gentiles of wheat soaked in water. At the end of Avodah Zarah, 65b, he challenged him concerning wheat soaked in wine; Rava retracted in both cases. He was harmed in the episode about pairs (Pesahim 110a). Rava attributed the harm to the public challenge that had embarrassed him. There the name is Rava bar Levai.
